policy.similarity: Published SuCOS-shape times pocket coverage, maximum to training systems before 1 June 2023; not sequence identity.
policy.binEdges: Left-inclusive/right-exclusive, except 100 belongs to the final bin.
policy.selection: All independently qualifying low-bin cases; stable SHA-256 order elsewhere. At most two cases per exact protein sequence and three per supplied RnP cluster. Every exclusion/shortfall remains explicit.
policy.nativeGate: Independently recomputed all-observed-C-alpha ligand RMSD strictly below 2 A, using preserved same-model native output. No pocket or ligand refit.
